name: Vote Methods 5
definition: Information about the vote methods to be used.

VoteThroughNetwork.name: Vote Through Network
VoteThroughNetwork.definition: Network address through which a voting party can cast its vote via a structured message.

VoteByMail.name: Vote By Mail
VoteByMail.definition: Address where the voting ballot can be sent.

ElectronicVote.name: Electronic Vote
ElectronicVote.definition: Electronic address, e-mail or web site, where a security holder can vote.

VoteByTelephone.name: Vote By Telephone
VoteByTelephone.definition: Telephone number providing access to an automated voting system.
